test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What is the purpose of the two-day Hands-on Training Workshop on the e-SAKSHI Portal held in June 2024?

options.text: To demonstrate biometric tracking of MPLAD assets
To train officials on the revised fund flow procedure under MPLAD Scheme
To launch a new e-commerce platform for district development
To train MPs in drafting local development plans

solution:
The correct answer is __**To train officials on the revised fund flow procedure under MPLAD Scheme**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The two-day Hands-on Training Workshop on the e-SAKSHI Portal was organized to **train officials on the revised fund flow procedure under the Members of Parliament Local Area Development (MPLAD) Scheme.**
 
• The workshop focused on equipping officials with the knowledge and skills to **navigate and utilize the e-SAKSHI portal** effectively for monitoring MPLAD projects.
 
• The revised fund flow procedure aims at **greater transparency and efficiency** in the disbursement and utilization of MPLAD funds.
 
• Participants were trained on the **digital processes** required for project approval, fund allocation, and monitoring progress through the portal.
 
• The initiative is part of the government’s push towards **digitization and accountability** in public schemes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **MPLAD Scheme:**

 
 
• Launched in 1993, the MPLAD Scheme enables Members of Parliament to recommend development projects in their constituencies.
 
• The scheme focuses on creating durable community assets such as roads, schools, health centers, and drinking water facilities.
 
• Each MP is allocated a fixed amount annually to implement development works.
 
 
 
• **e-SAKSHI Portal:**
 
 
• The e-SAKSHI portal is an online platform designed to **track and monitor MPLAD projects** in real-time.
 
• It ensures **transparency and accountability** in project implementation by providing stakeholders with access to project updates.
 
• The portal is aligned with the government’s vision of leveraging technology for better governance.
 
 
 
• **Fund Flow Procedure:**
 
 
• The revised fund flow procedure under MPLAD Scheme emphasizes **direct electronic transfer of funds** to implementing agencies.
 
• This minimizes delays and ensures timely utilization of allocated resources.
 
 
 
• **Training Workshops:**
 
 
• Workshops like these are critical for **capacity building** among government officials.
 
• They help in the **adoption of new technologies and procedures** for efficient governance.
